// Time and tuning parameters.
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let BaselineWindow = 14d;
let PivotWindow = 60m;
// Stage A: k8s audit indicators associated with token and workload execution paths.
let K8sTokenAudit =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Kubernetes'
  | extend AF = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
  | extend OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent),
           NamespaceNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesNamespace), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.namespace', tostring(RawEventData))))),
           PodNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesPodName), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.name', tostring(RawEventData)))))
  | where isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | where OpNorm has_any (
      'serviceaccounts/token',
      'tokenreviews',
      'pods/exec',
      'pods/attach',
      'secrets/get'
    )
  | summarize FirstK8s=min(Timestamp), LastK8s=max(Timestamp), K8sEventCount=count(), K8sOps=make_set(OperationName, 10)
    by IpNorm, UaNorm, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm;
// Build historical baseline of cloud operation tuples to identify first-seen pivots.
let CloudOpBaseline =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between ((StartTime - BaselineWindow) .. StartTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Azure'
  | extend OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent)
  | where isnotempty(IpNorm) and isnotempty(OpNorm)
  | summarize by IpNorm, UaNorm, OpNorm;
// Current sensitive cloud control-plane operations.
let CloudSensitiveCurrent =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Azure'
  | extend OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent)
  | where isnotempty(IpNorm) and isnotempty(UaNorm)
  | where OpNorm contains 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/listkeys/action'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/read'
  | project CloudTime=Timestamp, IpNorm, UaNorm, OpNorm, OperationName, AzureResourceId, ActionType, CountryCode, IsAnonymousProxy;
// Keep only novel cloud operation tuples for high-fidelity behavior change.
let CloudSensitiveNovel =
  CloudSensitiveCurrent
  | join kind=leftanti CloudOpBaseline on IpNorm, UaNorm, OpNorm;
// Correlate k8s precursor to novel cloud control-plane behavior.
K8sTokenAudit
| where isnotempty(UaNorm)
| join kind=inner CloudSensitiveNovel on IpNorm, UaNorm
| where CloudTime between (FirstK8s .. (LastK8s + PivotWindow))
| summarize FirstK8s=min(FirstK8s),
            LastK8s=max(LastK8s),
            FirstCloud=min(CloudTime),
            LastCloud=max(CloudTime),
            K8sEventCount=max(K8sEventCount),
            CloudEventCount=count(),
            K8sOps=any(K8sOps),
            CloudOps=make_set(OperationName, 15),
            CloudResources=make_set(AzureResourceId, 20),
            Countries=make_set(CountryCode, 5),
            AnyAnonymousProxy=max(toint(IsAnonymousProxy))
  by IpNorm, UaNorm, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm
| extend TimeGenerated = FirstK8s
| order by CloudEventCount desc, FirstCloud desc

// Execution window and thresholds.
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let PivotWindow = 4h;
let SuccessActivity = dynamic(["succeeded", "success"]);
let KeyAuthTypes = dynamic(["accountkey", "sas"]);
let MinStorageOps = 25;
let MinFailures = 3;
let MinReads = 8;
// Stage A: successful Key Vault secret retrieval from management plane telemetry.
let KeyVaultSecretReads =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(Caller) and isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
  | extend CallerNorm=tolower(Caller), CallerIp=tostring(CallerIpAddress),
           Op=tolower(OperationNameValue),
           Status=tolower(tostring(ActivityStatusValue)),
           SubStatus=tolower(tostring(ActivitySubstatusValue))
  | where Op has "microsoft.keyvault/vaults/secrets/"
  | where Op in~ ("microsoft.keyvault/vaults/secrets/get", "microsoft.keyvault/vaults/secrets/read")
  | where Status in (SuccessActivity) or SubStatus has "ok"
  // Collapse duplicate activity stages into one logical secret-read action.
  | extend ActionKey = iff(
      isnotempty(CorrelationId),
      strcat(CorrelationId, "|", CallerNorm, "|", Op, "|", tostring(ResourceId)),
      strcat(CallerNorm, "|", CallerIp, "|", tostring(SubscriptionId), "|", Op, "|", tostring(ResourceId), "|", tostring(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)))
    )
  | summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by ActionKey
  | summarize FirstKvRead=min(TimeGenerated), LastKvRead=max(TimeGenerated),
              KvReadCount=count(), KvOps=make_set(OperationNameValue, 20),
              KvResources=make_set(ResourceId, 30)
    by CallerNorm, CallerIp;
// Stage B: key-auth storage activity with per-actor summary.
let StorageActivity =
  CloudStorageAggregatedEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend IPAddress = coalesce(column_ifexists('IPAddress', ''), column_ifexists('IpAddress', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | extend ActorNorm=tolower(tostring(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, AccountApplicationId))),
           IpNorm=tostring(IPAddress),
           AuthNorm=tolower(tostring(AuthenticationType)),
           StorageNorm=tolower(tostring(StorageAccount))
  | where isnotempty(ActorNorm) and isnotempty(IpNorm) and isnotempty(StorageNorm)
  | where AuthNorm in (KeyAuthTypes)
  | summarize FirstStorage=min(Timestamp), LastStorage=max(Timestamp),
              StorageEvents=count(), StorageAccounts=dcount(StorageNorm),
              TotalOps=sum(tolong(coalesce(OperationsCount, 0))),
              TotalSuccess=sum(tolong(coalesce(SuccessfulOperationsCount, 0))),
              TotalFailures=sum(tolong(coalesce(FailedOperationsCount, 0))),
              TotalReads=sum(tolong(coalesce(SuccessfulReadOperations, 0))),
              TotalResponseBytes=sum(tolong(coalesce(TotalResponseLength, 0))),
              Services=make_set(ServiceType, 10),
              Accounts=make_set(StorageAccount, 30),
              Containers=make_set(StorageContainer, 30),
              UserAgents=make_set(UserAgentHeader, 10)
    by ActorNorm, IpNorm;
// Stage correlation: secret retrieval followed by mixed-outcome storage behavior.
KeyVaultSecretReads
| join kind=inner StorageActivity on $left.CallerNorm == $right.ActorNorm and $left.CallerIp == $right.IpNorm
| where FirstStorage between (FirstKvRead .. (LastKvRead + PivotWindow))
// Require meaningful activity and explicit mixed outcomes.
| where TotalOps >= MinStorageOps and TotalReads >= MinReads and TotalFailures >= MinFailures
| where TotalSuccess > 0 and TotalFailures > 0
| extend IdentityName = iff(CallerNorm contains "@", tostring(split(CallerNorm, "@")[0]), CallerNorm),
         IdentityUPNSuffix = iff(CallerNorm contains "@", tostring(split(CallerNorm, "@")[1]), ""),
         FailureToSuccessRatio = round(todouble(TotalFailures) / todouble(max_of(TotalSuccess, 1)), 3)
| project TimeGenerated=FirstKvRead,
          Identity=CallerNorm, IdentityName, IdentityUPNSuffix,
          SourceIp=CallerIp,
          FirstKvRead, LastKvRead, KvReadCount, KvOps, KvResources,
          FirstStorage, LastStorage,
          StorageEvents, StorageAccounts,
          TotalOps, TotalSuccess, TotalFailures, FailureToSuccessRatio,
          TotalReads, TotalResponseBytes,
          Services, Accounts, Containers, UserAgents
| order by TotalReads desc, TotalFailures desc

// Time and tuning parameters
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let BaselineWindow = 14d;
let PivotWindow = 6h;
let ScopeWindow = 6h;
let SuccessStatus = dynamic(['succeeded', 'success']);
// Stage A: successful Key Vault secret retrieval
let KvSecretReads =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(Caller) and isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
  | extend CallerNorm = tolower(tostring(Caller)),
           CallerIp = tostring(CallerIpAddress),
           Op = tolower(tostring(OperationNameValue)),
           Status = tolower(tostring(ActivityStatusValue)),
           SubStatus = tolower(tostring(ActivitySubstatusValue))
  | where Op has 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults/' and Op has '/secrets/'
  | where Op has_any ('/get', '/read')
  | where Status in (SuccessStatus) or SubStatus has 'ok'
  | summarize FirstKvRead=min(TimeGenerated), LastKvRead=max(TimeGenerated), KvReadCount=count() by CallerNorm, CallerIp;
// Stage B: successful SPN sign-ins in timeframe
let SpnSignins =
  AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where ResultType =~ 'Success' or ResultType == '0'
  | extend SpId = tolower(tostring(ServicePrincipalId)),
           AppIdNorm = tolower(tostring(AppId)),
           SigninIp = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent),
           CredNorm = tostring(ClientCredentialType)
  | where isnotempty(SpId) and isnotempty(SigninIp)
  | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, SpId, AppIdNorm, SpnName = tostring(ServicePrincipalName), Identity, SigninIp, UaNorm, CredNorm;
// Baseline historical scope touched by each principal in control
let ScopeBaseline =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTime - BaselineWindow) .. StartTime)
  | where isnotempty(Caller)
  | extend CallerNorm = tolower(tostring(Caller)),
           ScopeKey = tolower(tostring(coalesce(ResourceGroup, ResourceId, SubscriptionId))),
           Provider = tostring(ResourceProviderValue)
  | where isnotempty(ScopeKey)
  | summarize by CallerNorm, ScopeKey, Provider;
// Current scope touched by caller after suspicious SPN authentication
let ScopeCurrent =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(Caller)
  | extend CallerNorm = tolower(tostring(Caller)),
           ScopeKey = tolower(tostring(coalesce(ResourceGroup, ResourceId, SubscriptionId))),
           Provider = tostring(ResourceProviderValue),
           Op = tostring(OperationNameValue)
  | where isnotempty(ScopeKey)
  | project ActTime = TimeGenerated, CallerNorm, ScopeKey, Provider, Op, ResourceId, ResourceGroup, SubscriptionId, CallerIpAddress;
// Keep only novel scope for each caller.
let ScopeNovel =
  ScopeCurrent
  | join kind=leftanti ScopeBaseline on CallerNorm, ScopeKey, Provider;
// Correlate full chain: KeyVault read -> SPN sign-in -> novel scope
KvSecretReads
| join kind=inner (
    SpnSignins
    | extend JoinKeys = pack_array(SpId, AppIdNorm)
    | mv-expand JoinKey = JoinKeys
    | extend JoinKey = tostring(JoinKey)
    | project SigninTime, SpId, AppIdNorm, SpnName, Identity, SigninIp, UaNorm, CredNorm, JoinKey
  ) on $left.CallerNorm == $right.JoinKey and $left.CallerIp == $right.SigninIp
| where SigninTime between (FirstKvRead .. (LastKvRead + PivotWindow))
| join kind=inner ScopeNovel on $left.CallerNorm == $right.CallerNorm
| where ActTime between (SigninTime .. (SigninTime + ScopeWindow))
| summarize FirstKvRead=min(FirstKvRead),
            FirstSignin=min(SigninTime),
            FirstNovelScope=min(ActTime),
            NovelScopeCount=dcount(ScopeKey),
            Providers=make_set(Provider, 15),
            Operations=make_set(Op, 20),
            Scopes=make_set(ScopeKey, 30),
            ResourceIds=make_set(ResourceId, 20),
            ResourceGroups=make_set(ResourceGroup, 20),
            Subscriptions=make_set(SubscriptionId, 10)
  by CallerNorm, CallerIp, SpId, AppIdNorm, SpnName, Identity, UaNorm, CredNorm
| extend TimeGenerated = FirstKvRead
| where NovelScopeCount >= 2
| project TimeGenerated,
          Identity = CallerNorm,
          SourceIp = CallerIp,
          ServicePrincipalId = SpId,
          AppId = AppIdNorm,
          ServicePrincipalName = SpnName,
          FirstKvRead,
          FirstSignin,
          FirstNovelScope,
          NovelScopeCount,
          Providers,
          Operations,
          Scopes,
          ResourceIds,
          ResourceGroups,
          Subscriptions,
          UserAgent = UaNorm,
          ClientCredentialType = CredNorm
| order by NovelScopeCount desc, FirstNovelScope desc

// Time and tuning parameters.
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let ProcToK8sWindow = 15m;
let PivotWindow = 90m;
let MinCloudOps = 3;
// Stage A: pod processes with cloud CLI/token usage indicators.
let PodCloudCliSignals =
  CloudProcessEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(KubernetesNamespace) and isnotempty(KubernetesPodName)
  | extend NamespaceNorm = tolower(tostring(KubernetesNamespace)),
           PodNorm = tolower(tostring(KubernetesPodName)),
           Proc = tolower(tostring(ProcessName)),
           Cmd = tolower(tostring(ProcessCommandLine))
  | where (Proc has_any ('az', 'aws', 'gcloud', 'kubectl', 'curl', 'wget', 'pwsh', 'python')
           and Cmd has_any ('token', 'federated', 'oauth2', 'identity', 'keyvault', 'storage', 'sts.windows.net', 'login.microsoft.com'))
     or Cmd has_any (
          'az account',
          'az keyvault',
          'az storage',
          'oauth2/v2.0/token',
          'sts.windows.net',
          'azure_federated_token_file'
        )
  | project ProcTime=Timestamp, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, ContainerName, ContainerImageName, ProcessName, ParentProcessName, ProcessCommandLine;
// Stage B: bridge to source IP via Kubernetes audit for same namespace/pod.
let K8sAuditBridge =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Kubernetes'
  | extend AF = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
  | extend NamespaceNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesNamespace), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.namespace', tostring(RawEventData))))),
           PodNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesPodName), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.name', tostring(RawEventData))))),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent),
           OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName))
  | where isnotempty(NamespaceNorm) and isnotempty(PodNorm) and isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | where OpNorm has_any ('pods/exec', 'pods/attach', 'serviceaccounts/token', 'secrets/get')
  | project K8sTime=Timestamp, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, IpNorm, UaNorm, K8sOperation=OperationName;
// Stage C: cloud Key Vault and Storage operations from same source IP.
let CloudDataOps =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Azure'
  | extend OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent)
  | where isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | where OpNorm contains 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/listkeys/action'
  | where ActionType in~ ('Read', 'Update', 'Create', 'Other')
  | project CloudTime=Timestamp, IpNorm, UaNorm, CloudOperation=OperationName, AzureResourceId, ActionType, CountryCode, IsAnonymousProxy;
// Correlate process -> k8s audit -> cloud data operations.
PodCloudCliSignals
| join kind=inner K8sAuditBridge on NamespaceNorm, PodNorm
| where K8sTime between (ProcTime .. (ProcTime + ProcToK8sWindow))
| join kind=inner CloudDataOps on IpNorm
| where CloudTime between (K8sTime .. (K8sTime + PivotWindow))
| summarize FirstProcess=min(ProcTime),
            FirstK8s=min(K8sTime),
            FirstCloud=min(CloudTime),
            LastCloud=max(CloudTime),
            CloudEventCount=count(),
            K8sOps=make_set(K8sOperation, 10),
            CloudOps=make_set(CloudOperation, 20),
            CloudResources=make_set(AzureResourceId, 25),
            Countries=make_set(CountryCode, 5),
            AnyAnonymousProxy=max(toint(IsAnonymousProxy))
  by NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, IpNorm, ContainerName, ContainerImageName, ProcessName, ParentProcessName, ProcessCommandLine
| where CloudEventCount >= MinCloudOps
| extend TimeGenerated = FirstProcess
| order by CloudEventCount desc, FirstCloud desc

let starttime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let endtime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let NetworkConfigOps = dynamic([
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/azureFirewalls/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/azureFirewalls/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies/ruleCollectionGroups/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies/ruleCollectionGroups/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/frontDoorWebApplicationFirewallPolicies/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/frontDoorWebApplicationFirewallPolicies/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworkGateways/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworkGateways/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/routeTables/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/routeTables/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/routeTables/routes/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/routeTables/routes/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets/delete",
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write",
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/delete"
]);
let ApplianceIPs =
    DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where IsInternetFacing == true
    | where DeviceCategory in~ ("Network device", "Unknown")
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
    | join kind=inner (
        DeviceNetworkInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
        | mv-expand IP = parse_json(IPAddresses)
        | extend ApplianceIP = tostring(IP.IPAddress)
        | where isnotempty(ApplianceIP)
        | where ApplianceIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "0.0.0.0")
    ) on DeviceId
    | project ApplianceIP, ApplianceName = DeviceName, ApplianceOS = OSPlatform;
let UEBASignals =
    BehaviorAnalytics
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | summarize
        UEBAInvestigationPriority = max(InvestigationPriority),
        UEBAFirstTimeOp           = countif(tostring(ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserUsedApp) == "True"),
        UEBAFirstTimeCountry      = countif(tostring(ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserConnectedFromCountry) == "True")
      by UserPrincipalName;
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| where OperationNameValue in~ (NetworkConfigOps)
| extend Auth = parse_json(Authorization_d)
| where not (
    OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/delete"
    and tostring(Auth.evidence.role) =~ "PIM Contributor"
)
| extend CallerType = case(
    tostring(Auth.evidence.principalType) =~ "ServicePrincipal", "ServicePrincipal",
    Caller contains "@",                                          "User",
    tostring(Auth.evidence.principalType) =~ "User",             "User",
    "Unknown")
| extend CallerUPN = iff(Caller contains "@", Caller, "")
| extend ResourceCategory = case(
    OperationNameValue contains "networkSecurityGroup",   "NSG",
    OperationNameValue contains "firewallPolicies"
        or OperationNameValue contains "azureFirewall",   "Firewall",
    OperationNameValue contains "WebApplicationFirewall", "WAF",
    OperationNameValue contains "virtualNetworkGateway",  "VPN Gateway",
    OperationNameValue contains "routeTable"
        or OperationNameValue contains "routes/",         "Route Table",
    OperationNameValue contains "subnets",                "Subnet",
    OperationNameValue contains "roleAssignments",        "Role Assignment",
    OperationNameValue)
| extend ChangeAction = iff(OperationNameValue endswith "/delete", "Delete", "Write")
| project
    EventTime        = TimeGenerated,
    ResourceCategory,
    ChangeAction,
    OperationName    = OperationNameValue,
    ResourceGroup,
    ResourceId       = _ResourceId,
    Caller,
    CallerType,
    CallerUPN,
    CallerIpAddress,
    SubscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter UEBASignals on $left.CallerUPN == $right.UserPrincipalName
| extend UEBAFlagged = isnotempty(UEBAInvestigationPriority) and UEBAInvestigationPriority > 0
| join kind=leftouter ApplianceIPs on $left.CallerIpAddress == $right.ApplianceIP
| extend FromApplianceIP = isnotempty(ApplianceName)
| project-away UserPrincipalName, ApplianceIP
| extend SignalStrength = case(
    FromApplianceIP,                                               "High - caller IP matches known appliance",
    CallerType == "ServicePrincipal" and ChangeAction == "Delete", "High - SPN deleting network control",
    CallerType == "ServicePrincipal",                              "Medium - SPN modifying network config",
    UEBAFlagged and ChangeAction == "Delete",                      "Medium - UEBA-flagged user deleting control",
    UEBAFlagged,                                                   "Medium - UEBA-flagged user",
    "Low - review for context")
| extend
    AccountNameOnly  = tostring(split(CallerUPN, "@")[0]),

let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');

let RbacWindow = 60m;
// Baseline successful SPN sign-in tuples for rarity test
let SpnBaseline =

  | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTime - BaselineWindow) .. StartTime)
  | where ResultType =~ 'Success' or ResultType == '0'
  | extend SpId = tolower(tostring(ServicePrincipalId)),
           AppIdNorm = tolower(tostring(AppId)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent),
           CredNorm = tolower(tostring(ClientCredentialType))
  | where isnotempty(SpId) and isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | summarize by SpId, AppIdNorm, IpNorm, UaNorm, CredNorm;
// Current successful SPN sign-ins in hunt interval
let SpnCurrent =
  AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where ResultType =~ 'Success' or ResultType == '0'
  | extend SpId = tolower(tostring(ServicePrincipalId)),
           AppIdNorm = tolower(tostring(AppId)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent),
           CredNorm = tolower(tostring(ClientCredentialType))
  | where isnotempty(SpId) and isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated,
            SpId,
            AppIdNorm,
            SpnName = tostring(ServicePrincipalName),
            Identity,
            IpNorm,
            UaNorm,
            CredNorm,
            ResourceDisplayName,
            CorrelationId;
// Keep only first-seen tuples for high-fidelity hunting.
let SpnNovel =
  SpnCurrent
  | join kind=leftanti SpnBaseline on SpId, AppIdNorm, IpNorm, UaNorm, CredNorm;
// Collect RBAC-impacting control-plane write operations
let RbacWrites =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Succeeded' or ActivitySubstatusValue has 'OK'
  | extend Op = tolower(tostring(OperationNameValue)),
           CallerNorm = tolower(tostring(Caller))
  | where Op has_any (
      'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments/write',

// Correlate novel SPN sign-in to RBAC writes via ServicePrincipalId/AppId
SpnNovel
| extend JoinKeys = pack_array(SpId, AppIdNorm)

| extend JoinKey = tostring(JoinKey)

    RbacWrites
    | project WriteTime, CallerNorm, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, ResourceId, ResourceGroup, SubscriptionId, CorrelationId, Authorization_d
  ) on $left.JoinKey == $right.CallerNorm
// Require near-term temporal chain for stronger suspicion.
| where WriteTime between (SigninTime .. (SigninTime + RbacWindow))
| summarize FirstSignin=min(SigninTime),
            FirstRbacWrite=min(WriteTime),
            LastRbacWrite=max(WriteTime),
            RbacWriteCount=count(),
            Operations=make_set(OperationNameValue, 10),
            ResourcesTouched=make_set(ResourceId, 20),
            ResourceGroups=make_set(ResourceGroup, 20),

  by SpId, AppIdNorm, SpnName, Identity, UaNorm, CredNorm

// Time and tuning parameters.
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let ProcToK8sWindow = 20m;
let K8sToCloudWindow = 45m;
// Stage A: process-level signs of token access or cloud token exchange tooling in pods.
let PodTokenTooling =
  CloudProcessEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(KubernetesNamespace) and isnotempty(KubernetesPodName)
  | extend NamespaceNorm = tolower(tostring(KubernetesNamespace)),
           PodNorm = tolower(tostring(KubernetesPodName)),
           Cmd = tolower(tostring(ProcessCommandLine)),
           Proc = tolower(tostring(ProcessName)),
           ParentProc = tolower(tostring(ParentProcessName))
  | where Cmd has_any (
      '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token',
      'azure_federated_token_file',
      'oauth2/v2.0/token',
      'login.microsoft.com',
      'sts.windows.net',
      'az login',
      'get-azaccesstoken'
    )
    or (Proc has_any ('az', 'curl', 'wget', 'kubectl', 'pwsh', 'python')
        and Cmd has_any ('token', 'federated', 'oauth2', 'login.microsoftonline', 'sts.windows.net', 'serviceaccount'))
  | project ProcTime=Timestamp, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, KubernetesResource, ContainerName, ContainerImageName,
            ProcessName, ParentProcessName, ProcessCommandLine, AzureResourceId, ContainerId;
// Stage B: Kubernetes audit events that can expose token-abuse precursor context, including source IP.
let K8sAuditBridge =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Kubernetes'
  | extend AF = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
  | extend NamespaceNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesNamespace), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.namespace', tostring(RawEventData))))),
           PodNorm = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AF.KubernetesPodName), tostring(extractjson('$.objectRef.name', tostring(RawEventData))))),
           OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent)
  | where isnotempty(NamespaceNorm) and isnotempty(PodNorm) and isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | where OpNorm has_any (
      'pods/exec',
      'pods/attach',
      'serviceaccounts/token',
      'tokenreviews',
      'secrets/get',
      'serviceaccounts/get'
    )
  | project K8sAuditTime=Timestamp, NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, IpNorm, UaNorm, K8sOperation=OperationName, K8sResourceId=AzureResourceId;
// Stage C: Azure RBAC write operations from CloudAuditEvents.
let CloudRbacWrites =
  CloudAuditEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AzureResourceId = coalesce(column_ifexists('AzureResourceId', ''), column_ifexists('CloudResourceId', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where DataSource has 'Azure'
  | extend OpNorm = tolower(tostring(OperationName)),
           IpNorm = tostring(IPAddress),
           UaNorm = tostring(UserAgent)
  | where isnotempty(IpNorm)
  | where OpNorm contains 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments/'
     or OpNorm contains 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions/'
  | project CloudTime=Timestamp, IpNorm, UaNorm, CloudOperation=OperationName, CloudResourceId=AzureResourceId, ActionType, CountryCode, IsAnonymousProxy;
// Correlate A->B by namespace/pod and near-time.
PodTokenTooling
| join kind=inner K8sAuditBridge on NamespaceNorm, PodNorm
| where K8sAuditTime between (ProcTime .. (ProcTime + ProcToK8sWindow))
// Correlate B->C by source IP and near-time to represent k8s-to-cloud pivot.
| join kind=inner CloudRbacWrites on IpNorm
| where CloudTime between (K8sAuditTime .. (K8sAuditTime + K8sToCloudWindow))
| summarize FirstProcess=min(ProcTime),
            FirstK8sAudit=min(K8sAuditTime),
            FirstCloudWrite=min(CloudTime),
            LastCloudWrite=max(CloudTime),
            CloudWriteCount=count(),
            K8sOps=make_set(K8sOperation, 10),
            CloudOps=make_set(CloudOperation, 10),
            CloudResources=make_set(CloudResourceId, 20),
            Countries=make_set(CountryCode, 5),
            AnyAnonymousProxy=max(toint(IsAnonymousProxy))
  by NamespaceNorm, PodNorm, IpNorm, ContainerName, ContainerImageName, ProcessName, ParentProcessName, ProcessCommandLine
| extend TimeGenerated = FirstProcess
| order by CloudWriteCount desc, FirstCloudWrite desc

let KeyVaultSecretBurst =
  AzureActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | where isnotempty(Caller) and isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
  | extend CallerNorm=tolower(Caller), CallerIp=tolower(tostring(CallerIpAddress)),

// Execution window and phase split.
let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let CampaignWindow = EndTime - StartTime;
let PhaseSplit = StartTime + (CampaignWindow / 2.0);
let KeyAuthTypes = dynamic(["accountkey", "sas"]);
let MinEarlyFailures = 5;
let MinLateReads = 12;
let MinLateResponseBytes = 5000000;
// Normalize raw activity for both phases.
let NormalizedStorage =
  CloudStorageAggregatedEvents
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend IPAddress = coalesce(column_ifexists('IPAddress', ''), column_ifexists('IpAddress', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
  | extend ActorNorm=tolower(tostring(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, AccountApplicationId))),
           IpNorm=tostring(IPAddress),
           AuthNorm=tolower(tostring(AuthenticationType)),
           StorageNorm=tolower(tostring(StorageAccount))
  | where isnotempty(ActorNorm) and isnotempty(IpNorm) and isnotempty(StorageNorm)
  | where AuthNorm in (KeyAuthTypes)
  | project Timestamp, ActorNorm, IpNorm, AuthNorm, StorageNorm,
            StorageAccount, StorageContainer, ServiceType, UserAgentHeader,
            OperationsCount, SuccessfulOperationsCount, FailedOperationsCount,
            SuccessfulReadOperations, DistinctGetOperations, TotalResponseLength;
// Early phase captures failed exploration attempts.
let EarlyPhase =
  NormalizedStorage
  | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. PhaseSplit)
  | summarize EarlyFirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
              EarlyOps=sum(tolong(coalesce(OperationsCount, 0))),
              EarlySuccess=sum(tolong(coalesce(SuccessfulOperationsCount, 0))),
              EarlyFailures=sum(tolong(coalesce(FailedOperationsCount, 0))),
              EarlyAccounts=dcount(StorageNorm),
              EarlyTargets=make_set(StorageAccount, 20)
    by ActorNorm, IpNorm;
// Late phase captures successful read concentration after adaptation.
let LatePhase =
  NormalizedStorage
  | where Timestamp between (PhaseSplit .. EndTime)
  | summarize LateFirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
              LateOps=sum(tolong(coalesce(OperationsCount, 0))),
              LateSuccess=sum(tolong(coalesce(SuccessfulOperationsCount, 0))),
              LateFailures=sum(tolong(coalesce(FailedOperationsCount, 0))),
              LateReads=sum(tolong(coalesce(SuccessfulReadOperations, 0))),
              LateDistinctGets=sum(tolong(coalesce(DistinctGetOperations, 0))),
              LateResponseBytes=sum(tolong(coalesce(TotalResponseLength, 0))),
              LateAccounts=dcount(StorageNorm),
              LateTargets=make_set(StorageAccount, 20),
              Containers=make_set(StorageContainer, 30),
              Services=make_set(ServiceType, 10),
              UserAgents=make_set(UserAgentHeader, 10)
    by ActorNorm, IpNorm;
// Require explicit attacker adaptation: failures first, read-heavy access later.
EarlyPhase
| join kind=inner LatePhase on ActorNorm, IpNorm
| where EarlyFailures >= MinEarlyFailures
| where LateReads >= MinLateReads
| where LateResponseBytes >= MinLateResponseBytes
| where LateSuccess > 0
| extend LateReadToFailureRatio = round(todouble(LateReads) / todouble(max_of(EarlyFailures, 1)), 3),
         IdentityName = iff(ActorNorm contains "@", tostring(split(ActorNorm, "@")[0]), ActorNorm),
         IdentityUPNSuffix = iff(ActorNorm contains "@", tostring(split(ActorNorm, "@")[1]), "")
| project TimeGenerated=LateFirstSeen,
          Identity=ActorNorm, IdentityName, IdentityUPNSuffix,
          SourceIp=IpNorm,
          EarlyFirstSeen, EarlyOps, EarlySuccess, EarlyFailures, EarlyAccounts, EarlyTargets,
          LateFirstSeen, LateOps, LateSuccess, LateFailures, LateReads, LateDistinctGets,
          LateResponseBytes, LateAccounts, LateTargets,
          LateReadToFailureRatio,
          Containers, Services, UserAgents
| order by LateReads desc, EarlyFailures desc

    "/vpns/page.aspx",                 // CVE-2019-19781 - Citrix ADC directory traversal RCE

]);
let ApplianceVendors = dynamic([
    "Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Ivanti", "Pulse Secure",
    "SonicWall", "Cisco", "Check Point", "Juniper", "F5", "Citrix"]);
// Method 1: Known CVE exploitation URL paths in request or message
let CVE_URL_Hits =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where DeviceVendor in~ (ApplianceVendors)
    | where DeviceProduct !has "ASM"
    | where RequestURL has_any (CVEUrlPaths)
        or Message has_any (CVEUrlPaths)
    | where Message !has "Qualys" and Message !has "nessus"
    | extend CVEReference = case(
        RequestURL contains "/api/v1/totp/user-backup-code/"
            or Message contains "/api/v1/totp/user-backup-code/",    "CVE-2023-46805 (Ivanti auth bypass)",
        RequestURL contains "/api/v1/license/keys-status/"
            or Message contains "/api/v1/license/keys-status/",      "CVE-2024-21887 (Ivanti RCE)",
        RequestURL contains "/api/v2/cmdb/system/admin/"
            or Message contains "/api/v2/cmdb/system/admin/",        "CVE-2022-40684 (Fortinet auth bypass)",
        RequestURL contains "/vpns/page.aspx"
            or Message contains "/vpns/page.aspx",                   "CVE-2019-19781 (Citrix ADC directory traversal RCE)",
        RequestURL contains "/remote/fgt_lang?lang="
            or Message contains "/remote/fgt_lang?lang=",            "CVE-2018-13379 (Fortinet SSL VPN path traversal)",
        "Unknown CVE path")
    | project
        EventTime       = TimeGenerated,
        DetectionMethod = "Method1 - CVE URL path",
        CVEReference,
        SourceIP,
        DestinationIP,
        SourceUserName,
        DeviceVendor,
        DeviceProduct,
        DeviceAction,
        Activity,
        RequestURL,
        Message,
        Computer,
        SignalStrength  = "High - known CVE exploit path matched";
// Method 2: CVE ID string in appliance log message (vendor IPS catch-all)
let CVE_String_Hits =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where DeviceVendor in~ (ApplianceVendors)
    | where Message contains "CVE-20"
    | where Message !has "nessus.org"       // Nessus scanner DNS callbacks embedding CVE in hostname
        and Message !has "430002"           // Cisco FTD connection logs (traffic allowed, not threat)
        and DeviceProduct != "Cortex XDR"  // Endpoint detections, not appliance exploit indicators
        and DeviceProduct !has "ASM"       // F5 WAF detecting attacks against protected apps
    | extend CVEReference = extract(@"(CVE-\d{4}-\d+)", 1, Message)
    | project
        EventTime       = TimeGenerated,
        DetectionMethod = "Method2 - CVE string in log",
        CVEReference,
        SourceIP,
        DestinationIP,
        SourceUserName,
        DeviceVendor,
        DeviceProduct,
        DeviceAction,
        Activity,
        RequestURL,
        Message,
        Computer,
        SignalStrength  = "Medium - CVE reference in log message";
// Method 3: FortiCloud SSO authentication bypass -> local admin account creation (FG-IR-26-060)
let Forti_SSO_Logins =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
    | where DeviceAction == "FSSO-logon"
    | project SSOTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SourceIP;
let Forti_AdminCreate =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet"
    | where DeviceEventClassID == "0100044547"
    | where Message has "system.admin" and Message has "Add"
    | project AdminCreateTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, AdminMessage = Message;
let Forti_Sequence =
    Forti_SSO_Logins
    | join kind=inner Forti_AdminCreate on Computer
    | where AdminCreateTime > SSOTime
        and AdminCreateTime < SSOTime + postExploitWindow
    | project
        EventTime       = SSOTime,
        DetectionMethod = "Method3 - FortiCloud SSO auth bypass + admin create (FG-IR-26-060)",
        CVEReference    = "CVE-2026-24858 (FortiCloud SSO authentication bypass)",
        SourceIP,
        DestinationIP   = "",
        SourceUserName  = "",
        DeviceVendor    = "Fortinet",
        DeviceProduct   = "",
        DeviceAction    = "SSO login -> admin create",
        Activity        = strcat("Admin created at ", tostring(AdminCreateTime)),
        RequestURL      = "",
        Message         = AdminMessage,
        Computer,
        SignalStrength  = "High - SSO bypass then admin account created within 15 min";
// Combine all methods
union CVE_URL_Hits, CVE_String_Hits, Forti_Sequence
| extend SortPriority = case(
    SignalStrength startswith "High",   1,
    SignalStrength startswith "Medium", 2,
    3)
| sort by SortPriority asc, EventTime desc
| project-away SortPriority

let starttime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let endtime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let failureThreshold = 10;
let stuffingWindowMinutes = 60;
let sprayUserThreshold = 5;
let ApplianceVendors = dynamic([
    "Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Ivanti", "Pulse Secure",
    "SonicWall", "Cisco", "Check Point", "Juniper", "F5"]);
let FailureActions = dynamic(["deny", "denied", "block", "blocked", "drop", "dropped",
    "reject", "rejected", "failure", "failed", "invalid", "lockout"]);
let SuccessActions = dynamic(["allow", "allowed", "accept", "accepted", "permit", "permitted",
    "success", "login", "authenticated"]);
let AuthEvents =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where DeviceVendor in~ (ApplianceVendors)
    | where Activity has_any ("auth", "login", "vpn", "ssl", "tunnel", "session", "access", "logon")
        or Message has_any ("auth", "login", "vpn", "tunnel", "password", "credential")
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP)
    | where SourceIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "0.0.0.0", "")
    // Exclude IPsec / tunnel-lifecycle events (tunnel crypto, not credential auth)
    | where DeviceAction !in~ ("negotiate","install_sa","dpd","dpd_failure","esp_error",
        "tunnel-stats","phase2-up","phase2-down","tunnel-up","tunnel-down",
        "delete_phase1_sa","delete_ipsec_sa")
    | extend AuthResult = case(
        EventOutcome in~ ("failed", "failure"), "Failure",
        EventOutcome =~ "success", "Success",
        DeviceAction has_any (FailureActions)
            or Activity has_any ("fail", "denied", "invalid", "reject", "lockout"), "Failure",
        DeviceAction has_any (SuccessActions)
            or Activity has_any ("success", "login", "tunnel-up", "connected"), "Success",
        "Unknown")
    | where AuthResult in ("Failure", "Success")
    // Enrich SourceUserName when CEF suser field is empty
    | extend SourceUserName = coalesce(
        SourceUserName,
        DestinationUserName,
        extract(@'user="?([^\s"]+)"?', 1, AdditionalExtensions))
    | project
        EventTime     = TimeGenerated,
        AuthResult,
        SourceIP,
        SourceUserName,
        DeviceVendor,
        DeviceProduct,
        DeviceAction,
        Activity,
        Message,
        Computer;
// Pattern A: Credential Stuffing
let PatternA_Failures =
    AuthEvents
    | where AuthResult == "Failure"
    | where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
    | summarize
        FailureCount  = count(),
        FirstFailure  = min(EventTime),
        LastFailure   = max(EventTime),
        DeviceVendor  = take_any(DeviceVendor),
        DeviceProduct = take_any(DeviceProduct),
        Computer      = take_any(Computer)
      by SourceIP, SourceUserName;
let PatternA_Success =
    AuthEvents
    | where AuthResult == "Success"
    | where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
    | project SuccessTime = EventTime, SourceIP, SourceUserName, SuccessActivity = Activity;
let PatternA =
    PatternA_Failures
    | where FailureCount >= failureThreshold
    | join kind=inner PatternA_Success on SourceIP, SourceUserName
    | where SuccessTime > LastFailure
    | where datetime_diff('minute', SuccessTime, FirstFailure) <= stuffingWindowMinutes
    | project
        PatternType   = "A - Credential Stuffing",
        FirstSeen     = FirstFailure,
        LastFailure,
        SuccessTime,
        SourceIP,
        TargetUser    = SourceUserName,
        DistinctUsers = 1,
        FailureCount,
        DeviceVendor,
        DeviceProduct,
        Computer,
        SignalStrength = iff(FailureCount >= 50, "High", "Medium");
// Pattern B: Password Spray
let PatternB_Failures =
    AuthEvents
    | where AuthResult == "Failure"
    | where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
    | summarize
        DistinctUsers = dcount(tolower(SourceUserName)),
        FailureCount  = count(),
        FirstFailure  = min(EventTime),
        LastFailure   = max(EventTime),
        UserSample    = make_set(tolower(SourceUserName)),
        DeviceVendor  = take_any(DeviceVendor),
        DeviceProduct = take_any(DeviceProduct),
        Computer      = take_any(Computer)
      by SourceIP;
let PatternB_Success =
    AuthEvents
    | where AuthResult == "Success"
    | where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
    | project SuccessTime = EventTime, SourceIP, SuccessUser = SourceUserName;
let PatternB =
    PatternB_Failures
    | where DistinctUsers >= sprayUserThreshold
    | join kind=inner PatternB_Success on SourceIP
    | where SuccessTime > LastFailure
    | where datetime_diff('minute', SuccessTime, FirstFailure) <= stuffingWindowMinutes
    | where array_index_of(UserSample, tolower(SuccessUser)) != -1
    | project
        PatternType   = "B - Password Spray",
        FirstSeen     = FirstFailure,
        LastFailure,
        SuccessTime,
        SourceIP,
        TargetUser    = tostring(UserSample),
        DistinctUsers,
        FailureCount,
        DeviceVendor,
        DeviceProduct,
        Computer,
        SignalStrength = iff(DistinctUsers >= 20, "High", "Medium");
union PatternA, PatternB
| summarize
     FirstSuccessTime  = min(SuccessTime),
     LastSuccessTime   = max(SuccessTime),
     SuccessEventCount = count()
   by PatternType, FirstSeen, LastFailure, SourceIP, TargetUser, DistinctUsers,
      FailureCount, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, Computer, SignalStrength
| extend GapSeconds = datetime_diff('second', FirstSuccessTime, LastFailure)
| extend SignalStrength = case(
    PatternType == "A - Credential Stuffing"
        and FailureCount >= 50
        and GapSeconds <= 120,              "Critical - high failures + immediate success",
    PatternType == "B - Password Spray"
        and DistinctUsers >= 20
        and GapSeconds <= 120,              "Critical - wide spray + immediate success",
    GapSeconds <= 30,                       "High - immediate success after failures",
    PatternType == "A - Credential Stuffing"
        and FailureCount >= 50,             "High",
    PatternType == "B - Password Spray"
        and DistinctUsers >= 20,            "High",
    GapSeconds <= 120,                      "Medium - quick success after failures",
                                            "Medium")
| sort by FirstSuccessTime desc

        RiskLevelAggregated   = column_ifexists('RiskLevelAggregated', ''),
        Country               = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),

// Pattern A: Credential Stuffing - many failures on same user from same IP, then success
let PatternA =
    Failures
    | summarize
        FailureCount = count(),
        FirstFailure = min(FailTime),
        LastFailure  = max(FailTime)
      by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName
    | where FailureCount >= failureThreshold
    | join kind=inner Successes on UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName
    | where SuccessTime > LastFailure
    | where datetime_diff('minute', SuccessTime, FirstFailure) <= stuffingWindowMinutes
    | project
        PatternType           = "A - Credential Stuffing",
        HuntTime              = SuccessTime,
        UserPrincipalName,
        IPAddress,
        AppDisplayName,
        Country,
        City,
        FailureCount,
        DistinctUsers         = 1,
        FirstFailure,
        RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
        RiskLevelAggregated,
        SignalStrength        = iff(FailureCount >= 50, "High", "Medium");
// Pattern B: Password Spray - same IP targets many distinct users, at least one success
let PatternB_Failures =
    Failures
    | summarize
        DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
        FailureCount  = count(),
        FirstFailure  = min(FailTime),
        LastFailure   = max(FailTime),
        UserSample    = make_set(UserPrincipalName)
      by IPAddress, AppDisplayName;
let PatternB =
    PatternB_Failures
    | where DistinctUsers >= sprayUserThreshold
    | join kind=inner Successes on IPAddress, AppDisplayName
    | where SuccessTime > LastFailure
    | where datetime_diff('minute', SuccessTime, FirstFailure) <= stuffingWindowMinutes
    // Success user must be one of the sprayed accounts - avoids FP from unrelated logins on shared IPs
    | where array_index_of(UserSample, UserPrincipalName) != -1
    | project
        PatternType           = "B - Password Spray",
        HuntTime              = SuccessTime,
        UserPrincipalName,
        IPAddress,
        AppDisplayName,
        Country,
        City,
        FailureCount,
        DistinctUsers,
        FirstFailure,
        RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
        RiskLevelAggregated,
        SignalStrength        = iff(DistinctUsers >= 20, "High", "Medium");
union PatternA, PatternB
| extend TimeDeltaMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', HuntTime, FirstFailure)
| extend AccountName      = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0])
| extend AccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
| sort by HuntTime desc

let StartTime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let EndTime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let BaselineStart = StartTime - 14d;
let BaselineEnd = EndTime + 1d;
// Build latest hybrid identity keys for cross-platform joins.
let HybridUsersRaw =
  IdentityInfo
  | extend Timestamp = column_ifexists('Timestamp', TimeGenerated)
  | extend AccountUpn = coalesce(column_ifexists('AccountUpn', ''), column_ifexists('AccountUPN', ''))
  | where Timestamp between (BaselineStart .. BaselineEnd)
  | where column_ifexists('IdentityEnvironment', '') =~ "Hybrid" or (isnotempty(column_ifexists('AccountSID', '')) and isnotempty(AccountObjectId))
  | project Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, AccountDomain, AccountName, BlastRadius
  | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AccountObjectId
  | extend UPNKey = tolower(AccountUpn),
           SamKey = tolower(strcat(AccountDomain, "\\", AccountName));
// Normalize identity keys to one join key.
let HybridUsers =
  union isfuzzy=true
    (HybridUsersRaw | where isnotempty(UPNKey) | project UserKey = UPNKey, HybridUPN = AccountUpn, HybridSam = strcat(AccountDomain, "\\", AccountName), BlastRadius),
    (HybridUsersRaw | where isnotempty(SamKey) | project UserKey = SamKey, HybridUPN = AccountUpn, HybridSam = strcat(AccountDomain, "\\", AccountName), BlastRadius);
// Keep latest hybrid or Entra-joined devices likely to bridge cloud and on-prem.
let HybridDevicesRaw =
  DeviceInfo
  | where TimeGenerated between (BaselineStart .. BaselineEnd)
  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, JoinType, AadDeviceId, IsAzureADJoined
  | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
  | where IsAzureADJoined == true or tostring(JoinType) has_any ("Hybrid", "Azure AD", "Entra")
  | project DeviceId, HybridDeviceName = DeviceName, JoinType, AadDeviceId, IsAzureADJoined;
let HybridDevices =
  union isfuzzy=true
    (HybridDevicesRaw | where isnotempty(DeviceId) | project DeviceJoinKey = tolower(DeviceId), HybridDeviceName, JoinType, AadDeviceId, IsAzureADJoined),
    (HybridDevicesRaw | where isnotempty(HybridDeviceName) | project DeviceJoinKey = tolower(HybridDeviceName), HybridDeviceName, JoinType, AadDeviceId, IsAzureADJoined);
// Identify successful RDP logons by candidate hybrid identities.
let RdpSessions =
  _Im_Authentication(starttime=StartTime, endtime=EndTime)
  | where EventResult in~ ("Success", "Partial")
  | where EventSubType =~ "RemoteInteractive"
  | extend UserKey = tolower(coalesce(ActorUsername, TargetUsername)),
           DeviceJoinKey = tolower(coalesce(TargetDvcId, DvcId, TargetFQDN, DvcHostname)),
           SourceIP = tostring(SrcIpAddr),
           InitiatorUPN = tostring(ActorUsername)
  | where isnotempty(UserKey)
  | where isnotempty(DeviceJoinKey)
  | project RdpTime = TimeGenerated, DeviceJoinKey, UserKey, SourceIP, IsLocalAdmin = false, InitiatorUPN;
// Gather successful cloud sign-ins for same user keys.
let CloudUserSignins =
  _Im_Authentication(starttime=StartTime, endtime=(EndTime + 1d))
  | where EventResult in~ ("Success", "Partial")
  | where EventProduct =~ "Microsoft Entra ID"
  | where LogonProtocol has_any ("OAuth", "OpenID", "SAML")
    or LogonMethod in~ ("Service Principal", "Managed Identity", "Username & Password", "Multi factor authentication", "Passwordless", "PKI")
  | extend UserKey = tolower(coalesce(ActorUsername, TargetUsername)),
           CloudIP = tostring(SrcIpAddr),
           AppName = tostring(TargetAppName),
           ClientApp = tostring(ActingAppName)
  | where isnotempty(UserKey)
  | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserKey, CloudIP, AppName, ClientApp, ConditionalAccessStatus = "", CorrelationId = EventOriginalUid;
// Correlate RDP activity to near-term cloud access by the same hybrid identity.
RdpSessions
| join kind=inner HybridDevices on DeviceJoinKey
| join kind=innerunique HybridUsers on UserKey
| join kind=inner CloudUserSignins on UserKey
| where SigninTime between (RdpTime .. (RdpTime + 2h))
| summarize FirstCloudSignin = min(SigninTime),
            LastCloudSignin = max(SigninTime),
            CloudSigninCount = count(),
            Apps = make_set(AppName, 10),
            ClientApps = make_set(ClientApp, 10),
            CloudIPs = make_set(CloudIP, 10),
            CorrelationIds = make_set(CorrelationId, 10)
  by RdpTime, HybridDeviceName, JoinType, SourceIP, IsLocalAdmin,
    HybridUPN, HybridSam, BlastRadius, InitiatorUPN
| extend Confidence = iff(IsLocalAdmin == true or BlastRadius =~ "high", "High", "Medium")
| extend TimeGenerated = RdpTime
| order by TimeGenerated desc

let starttime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let endtime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let FederationEvents = materialize(
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
| where OperationName in ("Set domain authentication","Set federation settings on domain")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend ActorUPN=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         ActorIPAddress=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         ActorId=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id),
         TargetDomain=tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
         TargetDomainId=tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| mv-expand Detail = AdditionalDetails
| extend DetailKey=tostring(Detail.key), DetailValue=tostring(Detail.value)
| summarize FederationTime=min(TimeGenerated),
            OperationNames=make_set(OperationName),
            ActorUPN=any(ActorUPN),
            ActorIPAddress=any(ActorIPAddress),
            ActorId=any(ActorId),
            UserAgent=anyif(DetailValue, DetailKey == "User-Agent"),
            EventCount=dcount(Id)
          by TargetDomain, TargetDomainId);
let FederationActorIds = FederationEvents | where isnotempty(ActorId) | distinct ActorId;
FederationEvents
| join kind=leftouter (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
    | where UserId in (FederationActorIds)
    | where RiskLevelAggregated in ("medium","high")
    | extend RiskRank=case(RiskLevelAggregated =~ "high", 3, RiskLevelAggregated =~ "medium", 2, 1)
    | summarize LastRiskySignIn=max(TimeGenerated),
                arg_max(RiskRank, RiskLevelAggregated, IPAddress)
            by UserId
    | project UserId, LastRiskySignIn, MaxRiskLevel=RiskLevelAggregated, RiskySignInIP=IPAddress
) on $left.ActorId == $right.UserId
| extend IsPowerShell=UserAgent has_any ("PowerShell","python","curl","AADInternals")
| extend IsAnonymousActor=isempty(ActorUPN)
| extend SuspicionScore=toint(IsPowerShell)+toint(IsAnonymousActor)+toint(MaxRiskLevel in ("medium","high"))
| project FederationTime, TargetDomain, ActorUPN, ActorId, ActorIPAddress, OperationNames, EventCount,
          UserAgent, IsPowerShell, IsAnonymousActor, ActorRisk=MaxRiskLevel, LastRiskySignIn, RiskySignInIP, SuspicionScore
| order by SuspicionScore desc, FederationTime desc

          MaxRiskLevel  = RiskLevelAggregated,

          RiskyLocation = Location;
MFAEvents
| join kind=inner RiskyUsers on $left.TargetUserId == $right.UserId

| project
    MFATime,

    TargetUserUPN,

    TargetUserId,

    AdminPerformedChange,

    MFARegistrationIP = ActorIP,

let starttime = todatetime('{{StartTimeISO}}');
let endtime = todatetime('{{EndTimeISO}}');
let dormancyWindow = 14d;
let CredentialAdditions = AuditLogs
 | where TimeGenerated between (starttime .. endtime)
 | where OperationName == "Add service principal credentials"
 | where Result =~ "success"
 | extend TargetSPId      = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
 | extend TargetSPName    = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
 | extend ActorUPN        = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)   // user actor (empty if app)
 | extend ActorUserId     = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)
 | extend ActorAppName    = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)          // app actor (empty if user)
 | extend ActorAppId      = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId)
 | extend ActorIPAddress  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
 | extend Actor           = iif(isnotempty(ActorUPN), ActorUPN, ActorAppName)   // display only
 | extend ActorType       = case(isnotempty(ActorUPN), "User",
                                 isnotempty(ActorAppName), "App", "Unknown")
 | where isnotempty(TargetSPId)
 | project CredentialAddTime = TimeGenerated, TargetSPId, TargetSPName,
           ActorUPN, ActorUserId, ActorAppName, ActorAppId, ActorIPAddress,
           Actor, ActorType;
 let TargetSPIds = CredentialAdditions | distinct TargetSPId;
 let SPSignIns = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
 | where TimeGenerated between ((starttime - dormancyWindow) .. endtime)
 | where ResultType == "0"
 | where ServicePrincipalId in (TargetSPIds)
 | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalId;
 CredentialAdditions
 | join kind=leftouter (SPSignIns) on $left.TargetSPId == $right.ServicePrincipalId
 | summarize
     LastSignInBeforeAdd = maxif(SignInTime, SignInTime <  CredentialAddTime),
     FirstSignInAfterAdd = minif(SignInTime, SignInTime >= CredentialAddTime),
     TargetSPName   = take_any(TargetSPName),
     ActorUPN       = take_any(ActorUPN),
     ActorUserId    = take_any(ActorUserId),
     ActorAppName   = take_any(ActorAppName),
     ActorAppId     = take_any(ActorAppId),
     ActorIPAddress = take_any(ActorIPAddress),
     Actor          = take_any(Actor),
     ActorType      = take_any(ActorType)
   by TargetSPId, CredentialAddTime
 | where isnull(LastSignInBeforeAdd)
     or LastSignInBeforeAdd < (CredentialAddTime - dormancyWindow)   // dormant before the add
 | where isnotnull(FirstSignInAfterAdd)                              // ...then activated after
 | extend DormancyStatus = iif(isnull(LastSignInBeforeAdd),
     strcat("No sign-in in prior ", tostring(toint(dormancyWindow / 1d)), " days"),
     strcat(tostring(datetime_diff('day', CredentialAddTime, LastSignInBeforeAdd)), " days dormant"))
 | extend MinutesToActivation = datetime_diff('minute', FirstSignInAfterAdd, CredentialAddTime)
 | extend AnonymousActor = isempty(Actor)
 | project CredentialAddTime, TargetSPName, TargetSPId, ActorType, Actor,
           ActorUPN, ActorUserId, ActorAppName, ActorAppId, ActorIPAddress,
           DormancyStatus, LastSignInBeforeAdd, FirstSignInAfterAdd, MinutesToActivation,
           AnonymousActor
 | order by MinutesToActivation asc, CredentialAddTime desc

    SecurityImplications == "Device Wipe Disabled", "High",
    SecurityImplications == "Privilege Changes", "High",
    RiskLevel == "Unauthorized Change", "High",

let query_lookback = 14d;
let query_frequency = 5h;
let anomaly_threshold = 2.5;
let seasonality = -1;
let trend = 'linefit';
let step_duration = 5h;
let app_user_regex = "^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}\\.com$";
let guid_regex = "([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})";
let application_users = DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequency)
    | where UserId !endswith "@onmicrosoft.com" and UserId != "Unknown"
    | summarize by UserId
    | where split(UserId, "@")[1] matches regex app_user_regex;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(ago(query_lookback))
| where UserId in (application_users)
| where isnotempty(OriginalObjectId)
| make-series TotalEvents = count() default=0 on TimeGenerated from startofday(ago(query_lookback)) to now() step step_duration by UserId, InstanceUrl, OriginalObjectId
| extend (Anomalies, Score, Baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(TotalEvents, anomaly_threshold, seasonality, trend)
| mv-expand
    TotalEvents to typeof(double),
    AnomalyTimeGenerated = TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime),
    Anomalies to typeof(double),
    Score to typeof(double),
    Baseline to typeof(long)
| where Anomalies > 0
| extend Details = bag_pack(
                       "TotalEvents",
                       TotalEvents,
                       "Anomalies",
                       Anomalies,
                       "Baseline",
                       Baseline,
                       "Score",
                       Score,
                       "OriginalObjectId",
                       OriginalObjectId
                   )
| summarize Details = make_set(Details, 100) by UserId, InstanceUrl, AnomalyTimeGenerated
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),
    AadUserId = extract(guid_regex, 1, tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]))
| project
    AnomalyTimeGenerated,
    UserId,
    AadUserId,
    InstanceUrl,
    Details,
    CloudAppId

let query_lookback = 14d;
let query_frequncy = 1h;
let defense_evasion_events = PowerPlatformAdminActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_lookback)
    | where EventOriginalType == "TenantIsolationOperation"
    | mv-expand PropertyCollection
    | where PropertyCollection.Name == "powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.isolation_policy.enabled"
    | where PropertyCollection.Value == "False"
    | summarize
        TenantIsolationRemovalTimestamp = max(TimeGenerated)
        by SecurityDisablingUser = ActorName
    | join kind=inner (
        PowerPlatformAdminActivity
        | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_lookback)
        | where EventOriginalType == "EnvironmentPropertyChange"
        | where PropertyCollection has "Property: SecurityGroupId, Old Value: , New Value: "
        | mv-expand PropertyCollection
        | extend
            GroupRemovalTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            InstanceUrl = tostring(iif(PropertyCollection.Name == "powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.url", PropertyCollection.Value, "")),
            EnvironmentId = tostring(iif(PropertyCollection.Name == "powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.name", PropertyCollection.Value, ""))
        | summarize InstanceUrl = max(InstanceUrl), EnvironmentId = max(EnvironmentId) by GroupRemovalTimestamp, SecurityDisablingUser = ActorName)
        on SecurityDisablingUser
    | summarize
        GroupRemovalTimestamp = max(GroupRemovalTimestamp),
        TenantIsolationRemovalTimestamp = max(TenantIsolationRemovalTimestamp)
        by SecurityDisablingUser, InstanceUrl, EnvironmentId;
let exfiltration_alerts = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequncy)
    | where Tactics has "Exfiltration"
    | where Entities has ('"AppId":32780')
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | extend AlertUPN = iif(Entities.Type == "account", strcat(Entities.Name, "@", Entities.UPNSuffix), "")
    | extend InstanceUrl = tostring(iif(Entities.AppId == 32780, Entities.InstanceName, ""))
    | join kind=inner defense_evasion_events on InstanceUrl
    | where StartTime > TenantIsolationRemovalTimestamp and StartTime > GroupRemovalTimestamp
    | summarize InstanceUrl = max(InstanceUrl), AlertUPN = max(AlertUPN) by AlertName, SystemAlertId
    | extend AlertDetails = bag_pack("AlertName", AlertName, "SystemAlertId", SystemAlertId)
    | summarize AlertDetails = make_set(AlertDetails, 100) by AlertUPN, InstanceUrl
    | join kind=inner (
        AuditLogs
        | where OperationName == "Update user"
        | where Identity == "Microsoft Invitation Acceptance Portal"
        | mv-expand TargetResources
        | extend ModifiedProperties = TargetResources.modifiedProperties
        | mv-expand ModifiedProperties
        | where ModifiedProperties.displayName == "AcceptedAs"
        | summarize RedeemTime = max(TimeGenerated) by GuestUser = tostring(parse_json(replace_regex(tostring(ModifiedProperties.newValue), "\\r", ""))[0]))
        on $left.AlertUPN == $right.GuestUser;
defense_evasion_events
| join kind=inner exfiltration_alerts on InstanceUrl
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(SecurityDisablingUser, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(SecurityDisablingUser, "@")[1]),
    GuestAccountName = tostring(split(GuestUser, "@")[0]),
    GuestUPNSuffix = tostring(split(GuestUser, "@")[0]),
    DataverseId = 32780
| project
    SecurityDisablingUser,
    GuestUser,
    AlertDetails,
    TenantIsolationRemovalTimestamp,
    GroupRemovalTimestamp,
    InstanceUrl,
    EnvironmentId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    GuestAccountName,
    GuestUPNSuffix,
    DataverseId

// Set a mass export threshold for users who have no historical activity.
let mass_export_threshold = 10000;
let query_lookback = 14d;
let query_frequency = 1h;
let export_activity = DataverseActivity
    | where Message == "ExportToExcel"
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults has ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), double(1));

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(query_frequency)
    | extend RecordId = split(QueryResults, ",")
    | summarize
        FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
        CurrentExportRate = sum(QueryCount),
        SampleRecordIds = make_set(RecordId, 1000)
        by UserId, InstanceUrl;
let historical_activity = export_activity
    | where TimeGenerated between(ago(query_lookback) .. ago(query_frequency))
    | summarize HistoricalBaseline = sum(QueryCount) by HistoricalUserId = UserId, InstanceUrl;
current_activity
| join kind=leftouter(historical_activity) on $left.UserId == $right.HistoricalUserId, InstanceUrl
| extend BaselineThreshold = iif(isnotnull(HistoricalBaseline), HistoricalBaseline, todouble(mass_export_threshold))
| where CurrentExportRate > BaselineThreshold
| join kind=inner(export_activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(query_frequency)
    | summarize EntityCount = sum(QueryCount) by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl, EntityName
    | extend Details = bag_pack("EntityName", EntityName, "EntityCount", EntityCount)
    | summarize Details = make_set(Details, 100) by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl)
    on UserId, InstanceUrl
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),

let role_create_watch_period = 2d;
let query_frequency = 1h;
let role_create_add_events= DataverseActivity
    | where Message == "Create" and EntityName == "role"
    | mv-expand Role = Fields
    | extend RoleName = Role.Value
    | where Role.Name == "name"
    | mv-expand Role = Fields
    | extend RoleCreateTime = TimeGenerated, RoleId = tostring(Role.Value)
    | where Role.Name == "roleid"
    | join kind=inner (
        DataverseActivity
        | where Message == "Associate" and EntityName == "systemuser"
        | mv-expand Role = Fields
        | where Role.Name == "role"
        | extend RoleMemberAddedTime = TimeGenerated, MemberAddedRoleId = tostring(Role.Value))
        on $left.RoleId == $right.MemberAddedRoleId, InstanceUrl, UserId
    | where RoleMemberAddedTime between (RoleCreateTime .. (RoleCreateTime + role_create_watch_period));
let remove_role_member_events = DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequency)
    | where Message == "Disassociate" and EntityName == "systemuser"
    | mv-expand Role = Fields
    | where Role.Name == "role"
    | extend ActionTime = TimeGenerated, MemberRemovedRoleId = tostring(Role.Value);
let role_delete_events = DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequency)
    | where Message == "Delete" and EntityName == "role"
    | extend DeletedRoleID = EntityId, Action = "Role deleted within defined time window"
    | project Action, ActionTime = TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIp, DeletedRoleID, InstanceUrl;
let role_member_removals = role_create_add_events
    | join kind=inner (remove_role_member_events) on $left.RoleId == $right.MemberRemovedRoleId
    | where ActionTime between (RoleCreateTime .. (RoleCreateTime + role_create_watch_period))
    | extend Action = "Role membership removed within defined time window";
let role_deletions = role_create_add_events
    | join kind=inner (role_delete_events) on $left.RoleId == $right.DeletedRoleID
    | where ActionTime between (RoleCreateTime .. (RoleCreateTime + role_create_watch_period));
union isfuzzy=true role_member_removals, role_deletions
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[1])
| project
    UserId,
    InstanceUrl,
    ClientIp,
    Action,
    RoleCreateTime,
    RoleName,
    ActionTime,
    CloudAppId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix

let query_frequency = 1h;
let query_lookback = 14d;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequency)
| where Message == 'ExecutePowerBISql'
| summarize FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated) by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl
| join kind=inner(
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_lookback)
    | where Message == 'ExecutePowerBISql'
    | summarize UniqueUsers = dcount(UserId, 4) by InstanceUrl)
    on InstanceUrl
| where UniqueUsers == 1
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityAlert
    | where Entities has ('"Type":"ip"')
    | project AlertName, SystemAlertId, Entities
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | where Entities.Type == "ip"
    | extend IPAddress = tostring(Entities.Address)
    | summarize SystemAlerts = make_set(SystemAlertId, 100), Alerts = make_set(AlertName, 100) by IPAddress)
    on $left.ClientIp == $right.IPAddress
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[1])
| join kind = inner (
    SecurityAlert
    | where Entities has ('Type":"account"')
    | project AlertName, SystemAlertId, Entities
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | where Entities.Type == "account"
    | extend
        UPNSuffix = tostring(Entities.UPNSuffix),
        AccountName = tostring(Entities.Name)
    | summarize SystemAlerts = make_set(SystemAlertId, 100), Alerts = make_set(AlertName, 100) by AccountName, UPNSuffix
    | where isnotempty(AccountName) and isnotempty(UPNSuffix))
    on AccountName, UPNSuffix
| summarize SystemAlerts = make_set(SystemAlerts, 100), Alerts = make_set(Alerts, 100) by FirstEvent, UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl, AccountName, UPNSuffix
| extend CloudAppId = int(32780)
| project
    FirstEvent,
    UserId,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    Alerts,
    SystemAlerts,
    CloudAppId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix

let dt_lookBack = 1h;
let ioc_lookBack = 14d;
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(ioc_lookBack) and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true
// Picking up only IOC's that contain the entities we want
| where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    or isnotempty(EmailSourceIpAddress)
    or isnotempty(NetworkDestinationIP)
    or isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP)
// As there is potentially more than 1 indicator type for matching IP, taking NetworkIP first, then others if that is empty.
// Taking the first non-empty value based on potential IOC match availability
| extend TI_ipEntity = iff(isnotempty(NetworkIP), NetworkIP, NetworkDestinationIP)
| extend TI_ipEntity = iff(isempty(TI_ipEntity) and isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP), NetworkSourceIP, TI_ipEntity)
| extend TI_ipEntity = iff(isempty(TI_ipEntity) and isnotempty(EmailSourceIpAddress), EmailSourceIpAddress, TI_ipEntity)
//Exclude local addresses, using the ipv4_is_private operator
| where ipv4_is_private(TI_ipEntity) == false
    and TI_ipEntity !startswith "fe80"
    and TI_ipEntity !startswith "::"
    and TI_ipEntity !startswith "127."
// using innerunique to keep perf fast and result set low, we only need one match to indicate potential malicious activity that needs to be investigated
| join kind=innerunique (
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(dt_lookBack)
    | where isnotempty(ClientIp)
    //Exclude local addresses, using the ipv4_is_private operator
    | where ipv4_is_private(ClientIp) == false
        and ClientIp !startswith "fe80"
        and ClientIp !startswith "::"
        and ClientIp !startswith "127."
    // renaming time column so it is clear the log this came from
    | extend DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated = TimeGenerated
    )
    on $left.TI_ipEntity == $right.ClientIp
| where DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated < ExpirationDateTime
| summarize DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated = arg_max(DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId, ClientIp
| project DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated, Description, ActivityGroupNames, IndicatorId, ThreatType, Url, ExpirationDateTime, ConfidenceScore,
    TI_ipEntity, ClientIp, NetworkIP, NetworkDestinationIP, NetworkSourceIP, EmailSourceIpAddress, InstanceUrl, UserId
| extend
    timestamp = DataverseActivity_TimeGenerated,
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    CloudAppId = int(32780)

// Note this detection relies upon the user's UPN matching their email address.
// UEBA can provide more accurate data if enabled.
let query_frequency = 1h;
let allowed_destination_smtp_domains = dynamic([
// Specify a list of recipient domains to exclude from alerting.
// Example:
// "microsoft.com", "contoso.com"
    ]);
let exfiltration_alert_users = SecurityAlert
    | where Tactics has 'Exfiltration' and Entities has_all ('account', '32780')
    | mv-expand DataverseEntities = todynamic(Entities)
    | where DataverseEntities.AppId == 32780
    | extend InstanceUrl = tostring(DataverseEntities.InstanceName)
    | mv-expand AccountEntities = todynamic(Entities)
    | where AccountEntities.Type == 'account'
    | extend
        AccountName = tostring(AccountEntities.Name),
        UPNSuffix = tostring(AccountEntities.UPNSuffix)
    | summarize InstanceUrls = make_set(InstanceUrl, 100) by AccountName, UPNSuffix
    | extend UserId = tolower(strcat(AccountName, "@", UPNSuffix));
exfiltration_alert_users
| join kind=inner (
    MSBizAppsTerminatedEmployees
    | project UserId = tolower(UserPrincipalName), NotificationDate
    | where startofday(NotificationDate) <= startofday(now()))
    // Uncomment the below KQL if UEBA is available to gain more accurate
    // email address data:
    // | join kind=leftouter (_ASIM_IdentityInfo) on $left.UserId == $right.Username
    // | extend UserId = iif(UserId == UserMailAddress or isempty(UserMailAddress), UserId, UserMailAddress))
    on UserId
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago (query_frequency)
    | where EmailDirection == "Outbound" and AttachmentCount > 0
    | extend RecipientDomain = tolower(split(RecipientEmailAddress, '@')[1])
    | where RecipientDomain !in (allowed_destination_smtp_domains)
    | summarize
        RecipientAddresses = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 1000),
        Subject = make_set(Subject, 1000)
        by SenderAddress = tolower(SenderMailFromAddress), SenderIPv4)
    on $left.UserId == $right.SenderAddress
| mv-expand InstanceUrl = InstanceUrls to typeof(string)
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1])
| project
    UserId,
    InstanceUrl,
    SenderIPv4,
    RecipientAddresses,
    Subject,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    CloudAppId

let query_frequency = 1h;
let query_lookback = 14d;
let cookie_lifetime = 24h;
let cookie_binding_disabled_events = DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_lookback)
    | where Message == "Update" and EntityName == "organization"
    | mv-expand Fields
    | where Fields.Name == "enableipbasedcookiebinding" and Fields.Value == 'False'
    | summarize CookieBindingDisabled = min(TimeGenerated) by CookieBindingDisabledBy = UserId, InstanceUrl;
let current_activity = cookie_binding_disabled_events
    | join kind=inner(DataverseActivity
        | where UserId !endswith "@onmicrosoft.com" and UserId !endswith "@microsoft.com"
        | where isnotempty(ClientIp) and isnotempty(UserAgent)
        | where TimeGenerated >= ago(query_frequency + cookie_lifetime)
        | summarize LatestEvent = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl)
        on InstanceUrl;
let users_switched_ip = current_activity
    | summarize IPCount = count() by UserId, InstanceUrl
    | where IPCount > 1
    | join kind=inner (current_activity) on UserId, InstanceUrl
    | summarize arg_max(LatestEvent, *) by UserId, InstanceUrl;
users_switched_ip
| join kind = inner (DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago (query_lookback)
    | where UserId !endswith "@onmicrosoft.com" and UserId !endswith "@microsoft.com"
    | where isnotempty(ClientIp) and isnotempty(UserAgent)
    | project-rename
        HistoricalTime = TimeGenerated,
        HistoricalIP = ClientIp,
        HistoricalAgent = UserAgent)
    on UserId, InstanceUrl
| where HistoricalTime >= ago(query_lookback) and HistoricalTime < LatestEvent
| summarize
    HistoricalIPs = make_set(HistoricalIP, 100),
    HistoricalAgents = make_set(HistoricalAgent, 100)
    by
    UserId,
    UserAgent,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    LatestEvent,
    CookieBindingDisabled,
    CookieBindingDisabledBy
| where (HistoricalIPs !has ClientIp) and (HistoricalAgents !has UserAgent)
| extend
    CloudAppId = int(32780),
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[1])
| project
    LatestEvent,
    UserId,
    ClientIp,
    UserAgent,
    InstanceUrl,
    HistoricalIPs,
    HistoricalAgents,
    CookieBindingDisabled,
    CookieBindingDisabledBy,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    CloudAppId

let baseline_time = 14d;
let detection_time = 1d;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated between(ago(baseline_time) .. ago(detection_time - 1d))
| where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
| extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
| extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
| extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
| summarize sum(QueryCount) by UserId
| extend HistoricalBaseline = sum_QueryCount
| join kind=inner (
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
    | summarize sum(QueryCount) by UserId
    | extend CurrentExportRate = sum_QueryCount)
    on UserId
| where CurrentExportRate > HistoricalBaseline
| project UserId, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate
| join kind=inner(
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1)))
    on UserId
| summarize
    QuerySizes = make_set(QueryCount),
    MostRecentQuery = max(TimeGenerated),
    IPs = make_set(ClientIp),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent),
    Entities = make_set(EntityName),
    Queries = make_set(Query)
    by UserId, InstanceUrl, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[1]),
    CloudAppId = int(32780)
| project
    MostRecentQuery,
    UserId,
    IPs,
    UserAgents,
    InstanceUrl,
    Queries,
    QuerySizes,
    Entities,
    HistoricalBaseline,
    CurrentExportRate,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    CloudAppId
